files.use: No longer used by Nutrition since 2026-11-19 (replaced by models/asha-food-66-int8.onnx); kept for older cached pages.

files.source: Built by ASHA: Keras Applications EfficientNetV2-B0 ImageNet weights (https://storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/keras-applications/efficientnet_v2/efficientnetv2-b0_notop.h5) + a logistic-regression head trained on Open Images V7 food photos, BD-Food33 and Bangladeshi Street Food photos, exported with tf2onnx (opset 17) and statically quantised to int8 (QDQ) with onnxruntime. Scripts: scripts/public-data-validation/nutrition/
files.license: Backbone Apache-2.0; training images: Open Images V7 (CC BY 2.0 images, CC BY 4.0 labels), BD-Food33 (CC0), Bangladeshi Street Food (CC BY 4.0)
files.use: Nutrition: on-device food recognition (65 foods incl. 31 Bangladeshi dishes + not food), experimental, always confirmed by the person
